dataset_versioning: Freeze questions and reference outputs before each comparison; reuse a version only when its hash is unchanged.
experiments: One experiment per arm per local run; link every output to its reference example; retain original trace URLs.
failure_policy: Persist local dataset/results and pending sync status; retry upload without replaying model calls.
source_uploads: For benchmark-v2 and later, display per-question source excerpts and locations, full answers, all ranked candidates, citations, graph paths, fact coverage, timings, usage and paired differences. Do not upload PDF binaries, embeddings, credentials or raw provider payloads.
